curriculum.name: count_calls_with
curriculum.goal: Given a person, return how many calls there are with that person.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
